parameters.seed_policy: Use committed seeds or the custodian seed; never reselect after output.

measurement_procedure: In disposable exact-SHA clones, retain environment and raw stdout/stderr for locked sync, lint, TeX source validation, full tests, six examples, semantic artifact validation, Git cleanliness, two pdflatex passes, and six frozen mutations.
uncertainty_procedure: Command exits, test counts, structure, mutation rejection, and Git cleanliness are exact. Numeric drift uses only the committed semantic-checker tolerances.
statistical_analysis: Pass only if both platforms succeed at the exact candidate, Windows builds a nonempty PDF, regeneration is contract-equivalent, all corruptions are rejected, and no required result exists only in an agent summary. Missing commands, surviving mutations, dirty tracked outputs, or a platform-only result are failures.
mutation_plan: Add an unregistered noninformational check identity; require rejection.
Flip a required check pass outcome; require rejection.
Change a measurement array shape; require rejection.
Change a stable configuration beyond tolerance; require rejection.
Make a required visual empty and untracked; require both defects.
Move a sensitive scientific diagnostic beyond its frozen threshold; require rejection.
